fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-10-03 states that the complainant noticed that Rs. 50,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval, on 2025-10-02 at roughly 16:35. Lavanya Ammal reported the matter orally at Coimbatore South PS; the contact number given was 9000000175. Hariharan Prakash (mobile 9000000017) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The account reference SYN-ACC-100057 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots, a call detail reference and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Call detail reference; Bank transaction reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Funds reportedly routed through a chain of accounts.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, call detail, mobile number, afternoon, bank account, shopping complex, suspect
